title: Learning metrics
windowHint: Computed locally from the last {{days}} days. Nothing leaves this device.
loadFailed: Could not load metrics. Try again later.

northStar.label: Words recalled
northStar.hint: Distinct words successfully recalled at least once in the window (rated Good or Easy). Reviewing the same word repeatedly still counts as one — this measures how many words stuck, not how many reviews you did.
northStar.caption: The number to watch: it grows only when words are successfully recalled.

weeklyRecallWords.label: Words recalled in window
weeklyRecallWords.hint: Distinct words successfully recalled at least once in the window.

retention7.label: 7-day review success rate
retention7.hint: Share of reviews completed in the last 7 days rated Good or Easy. This measures recent review quality, not first-learn cohort retention.

retention30.label: 30-day review success rate
retention30.hint: Share of successful recalls among reviews completed in the last 30 days. Compare with 7 days to see recent review quality, not first-learn cohort retention.

reviewCompletion.label: Review completion
reviewCompletion.hint: Reviews finished ÷ (finished + cards still due). A low value means the backlog is growing.

recommendationOpen.label: Recommendation open rate
recommendationOpen.hint: Share of recommendations opened, de-duplicated per video per day. Uses the same definition as the recommendation panel in Settings.

feedbackRate.label: Explicit feedback rate
feedbackRate.hint: Share of learning words exposed or interacted with in the window that the user explicitly marked as Known or Ignored. A low value suggests the word states are drifting out of date.

dueBacklog.label: Due backlog
dueBacklog.hint: Cards that are due right now and not yet reviewed. This is a count, not a rate.

practiceCoverage.label: Practice coverage
practiceCoverage.hint: Share of learning/familiar words that were shadowed, dictated, retold, role-played, or reviewed at least once. Opening a word card does not count.

interventionsPerTenMinutes.label: Interventions per 10 min
interventionsPerTenMinutes.hint: Needs playback duration data, which this version does not collect yet.

continueAfterSession.label: Continues watching after a session
continueAfterSession.hint: Needs post-session viewing data, which this version does not collect yet.

unavailable.title: Not available yet (no data source — this is not a value of zero)
